item.title: You don't need the best QB to win, just look at Jalen Hurts and Sam Darnold
item.description: Conventional thinking in the NFL still says you need an elite QB to win. But the past two Super Bowl champions say otherwise.

item.title: Antique & Collector Fair to showcase antiques and retro finds this March
item.description: Antique shoppers and vintage enthusiasts will have a chance to browse a wide range of collectibles this spring when the Antique & Collector Fair takes place at the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center in Oaks.

item.title: President's House slavery exhibits restored after judge imposes deadline
item.description: The Trump administration began reinstalling the slavery exhibits at the President's House in Independence National Historical Park on Thursday morning after Judge Cynthia Rufe ordered it be restored by 5 p.m. Friday. The exhibits tell the stories of nine slaves that George Washington kept in his Philadelphia home while president.

item.title: Grandson of the creator of Reese's Peanut Butter Cups accuses Hershey of 'diluting' ingredients
item.description: The grandson of the man who invented Reese's Peanut Butter Cups says Hershey is 'diluting' the brand and misleading consumers. The company says it uses substitutes in some new products, but the flagship candies remain unchanged.

item.title: 'Hidden Brain' podcast host Shankar Vedantam bringing live tour to Philly
item.description: Podcast listeners who enjoy psychology and behavioral science will get a chance to see "Hidden Brain" host Shankar Vedantam on stage in Philadelphia this spring.

item.title: Flyers Olympic check-in: Travis Sanheim, Rasmus Ristolainen will face off in Canada-Finland semifinal
item.description: One Flyer will be playing for a gold medal after Friday.

item.title: Three-year ban on unlicensed dog breeding in the city approved by council
item.description: Philadelphia City Council approved a three-year ban on unlicensed dog breeding Thursday, with the intention of reducing shelter overcrowding. The Animal Care and Control Team will be responsible for enforcing the legislation.

item.title: New Jersey sues Trump administration over cuts to energy affordability projects
item.description: New Jersey has joined 12 other states in suing the Trump administration. Their lawsuit claims the federal government terminated grant funding for energy efficiency projects to Democratic states as punishment for the shutdown.

item.title: Isaiah Zagar, who covered South Philly in murals, dies at 86
item.description: Famed mosaic artist Isaiah Zagar, who founded Philadelphia's Magic Gardens, died Thursday at the age of 86. He created over 200 mixed-media pieces with broken tiles, mirrors and bottles on public walls in his lifetime.

item.title: Instant observations: Sixers return from break, but skid resumes sans Joel Embiid
item.description: No matter what happens, the 2025-26 Sixers seem to always end up having their games go down to the wire. Thursday's return from the All-Star break was no different.
